summary_en: Annual dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 raised from 86 yen to 89 yen per share, reflecting upward revision of full-year earnings forecast.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief:
Keihan Holdings has revised upward its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027. The annual dividend per share has been increased by 3 yen, from the previously announced 86 yen to 89 yen per share. This revision reflects an upward revision of the company's full-year consolidated earnings forecast announced on the same date.

The company maintains a basic shareholder return policy centered on stable dividend payments based on earnings performance, combined with opportunistic share buybacks. Each period's dividend is set with reference to a consolidated payout ratio of approximately 30%, with the company aiming for sustained dividend growth through underlying earnings expansion. The company also balances profit distribution with maintaining financial soundness and achieving capital efficiency targets.

The final dividend for the fiscal year is now expected to be 89 yen per share, compared to 100 yen paid in the prior fiscal year ending March 2026.
